description: The mutation campaign for #260's acceptance work, part 1: the artifact FORMAT and the byte-level ATTESTATION (owner decisions B-2 and B-3). Every mutation edits a production surface — ownlang/repro.py or rust/crates/own-shadow/src/ — never a test, and every rule that exists on both sides is attacked on both. Four layers run for every mutation (discipline 3: no fail-fast), including the byte-variant ledger and the compare driver's own controls, because a format rule that only the artifact family can see is a format rule the gate cannot. M00 is the harness-honesty control.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference hashes the canonical form instead of the bytes it read
mutations.rule: B-2: the raw identity is taken BEFORE a decode or a parse

mutations.description: the port hashes the canonical form instead of the bytes it read
mutations.rule: B-2: the raw identity is taken BEFORE a decode or a parse

mutations.description: the writer PROMOTES a pre-v3 foreign entry by inventing a consumed
mutations.rule: B-3: every consumed comes from a run of the engine that claims it

mutations.description: the writer carries a pre-v3 foreign entry through unchanged
mutations.rule: B-3: an entry that attests nothing is dropped, never carried
mutations.pattern: missing = \[name for name in \(\"consumed\", \"derived\"\)\n                   if not isinstance\(entry\.get\(name\), dict\)\]

mutations.description: the reference accepts a non-canonical base64 spelling
mutations.rule: B-2: an encoding is canonical iff re-encoding its bytes reproduces it

mutations.description: the port's decoder discards the final group's stray bits
mutations.rule: B-2: an encoding is canonical iff re-encoding its bytes reproduces it

mutations.description: the port's base64 ENCODER drops a pad character
mutations.rule: B-2: an encoding is canonical iff re-encoding its bytes reproduces it — which couples the decoder to the encoder, and is the only way the re-encode backstop is reachable

mutations.description: the reference stops checking that the raw bytes reproduce the canonical identity
mutations.rule: B-2: parsing input.raw must land on input.canonical

mutations.description: the port stops checking that the raw bytes reproduce the canonical identity
mutations.rule: B-2: parsing input.raw must land on input.canonical

mutations.description: the reference accepts an engine that consumed other bytes
mutations.rule: B-2: every engine's consumed is input.raw's identity

mutations.description: the port accepts an engine that consumed other bytes
mutations.rule: B-2: every engine's consumed is input.raw's identity

mutations.description: the reference's bytes reader silently strips a UTF-8 BOM
mutations.rule: F.0's measured split: a BOM is in the INVALID class, refused by both readers
